about:
# Stone Reminders for Daylight

Clickable warlock stone reminders and a pet picker for Daylight UI.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Healthstone, soulstone and spellstone reminders.
- Missing-pet summon picker using known spells.
- Daylight-styled controls for warlock characters.

## Requirements

DaylightUI

## Controls

Daylight UI plugin settings.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `DaylightStones` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.2.1`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/StoneReminders/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
